title: ⚖️ Four senators demand companies disclose AI risks!
body: ⚖️ Four senators demand companies disclose AI risks!

A bipartisan group of four U.S. senators has introduced a bill requiring publicly listed companies to disclose more information about their AI systems, on the same day Anthropic's shares closed their first trading day up 17%.

The move follows Anthropic's record IPO, as lawmakers believe investors and the public deserve to know the risks of the models by the same standards applied to financial disclosure. Senator Elizabeth Warren, a member of the Senate Banking Committee, called for swift safeguards for advanced AI, while Representative Pramila Jayapal warned that the market cannot profit from a technology that could turn into a 'ticking time bomb'. Anthropic's shares closed their first day at $97.17, up 17% from the offering price of $83.

Simply put: imagine a company selling a powerful product without telling you its risks; the new bill wants AI companies treated like any listed company: disclosing their risks in numbers and to standards others can hold them to.
Do you support requiring AI companies to disclose the risks of their models?
